mentions.name: WebAuthn-based IndieAuth provider
mentions.description: An IndieAuth provider based on WebAuthn that handles authentication directly using credentials such as U2F keys or a device.
mentions.problem: Avoids relying on delegated authentication by handling it directly with WebAuthn (e.g., U2F keys or a device).
mentions.source_excerpt: An IndieAuth provider based on WebAuthn, the idea being that instead of relying on delegating authentication, it could be handled directly using, e.g., U2F keys or a device.

evidence.value: An IndieAuth provider based on WebAuthn, the idea being that instead of relying on delegating authentication, it could be handled directly using, e.g., U2F keys or a device.
